sentences.text:
App for Respondent/State : Mr. Borade P.G.
 ...
 Coram : K. L. Wadane, J.
 Date : 13Th December, 2018
Heard the learned counsel for the applicants.
Issue notice to the respondent, returnable on 03.01.2019.
The learned APP waives service of the notice for the sole-respondent.
2. The learned counsel for the applicants submits that on 27.04.1992, in all 10 samples Saffola Edible Oil were taken by the respondent and according to him, those were found adulterated.

The learned counsel for the applicant further submits that in all there were 10 complaints filed by the respondent/compliant with similar allegations for the offences punishable under Sections 7 and 16 read with 17 of the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1954 against the 911.odt applicant.

The learned counsel for the applicant further submits that, out of above 10 complaints, 8 complaints are quashed and set aside by this Court and allegations of the complaint in the present matter are similar to the complaints already quashed and set aside by this Court.

3. In view of the above and till examination of the entire material on record, there shall be interim relief in terms of prayer Clause "E".
4. Stand over to 03.01.2019.
